text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌۭ تُرْزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: speech opening for Joseph’s long answer; ordinary saying becomes the frame for authoritative teaching
words.root_gloss_range: speech/saying root; here the simple Form I verb introduces direct discourse and role reversal
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns Joseph from the evaluated prisoner into the speaker who controls the reply. The simple speech verb frames one long answer: first a verifiable promise about interpretation before food arrives, then a self-disclosure of creed and source of knowledge. It answers the prisoners' taʾwīl request (12:36) and opens the speech that moves toward the divine-knowledge argument (12:40). Its plain Form I opening contrasts with the heavier disclosure verb that follows.

topics.headline: authoritative speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s answer is framed as one controlled act of speech that reverses his prison role.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place direct speech after the verb, and the CRITICAL rows show the long reply moving from interpretation to creed.

topics.headline: surah speech-chain bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this speech continues the prison taʾwīl exchange and anticipates the theological argument that follows.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows tie the saying to 12:36 and to the speech sequence through 12:40-42.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening an exclusive no-arrival-unless frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) locks the opening into negation before the exception appears. The point is not a vague prediction about food but an exclusive frame: no provision-event reaches the two prisoners except with Joseph’s prior disclosure. This first negation also prepares the later negated faith clause.

topics.headline: exclusive negation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s prediction is framed as exhaustive restriction, not mere confidence.
topics.reason: The particle governs the first arrival verb and is completed by the exception particle.

words.gloss_range: arrival/reaching of food toward the two addressees inside a negated-exceptive prediction
words.root_gloss_range: coming/arrival root; here narrowed to a provision event reaching the prisoners
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيكُمَا}} ({{tr:yaʾtīkumā}}) makes the ordinary arrival of food the first testable event. The dual suffix keeps both prisoners inside the proof, while the imperfect under negation gives the coming a repeatable, foreseeable feel. The same arrival root will return under a different mood to mark the deadline.

topics.headline: arrival as proof event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary meal arrival becomes the verifiable event by which Joseph’s knowledge is tested.
topics.reason: The imperfect arrival verb is the predicate in the negated-exceptive frame and has food as its subject.

topics.headline: dual-address arrival reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both prisoners remain addressed through a repeated arrival verb that brackets the proof.
topics.reason: The dual suffix recurs on both arrival verbs, and the local reprise rows mark the bracket.

words.gloss_range: concrete food as an indefinite subject under negation and as the test object for interpretation
words.root_gloss_range: taste/eating/food root; here the edible provision branch is active, not abstract taste alone
words.prose: {{ar:طَعَامٌ}} ({{tr:ṭaʿāmun}}) grounds Joseph’s interpretive authority in something edible and ordinary. As an indefinite subject under negation, the food is not a named dish but any provision that reaches them. The concrete meal becomes the countdown marker by which prior knowledge can be verified.

topics.headline: indefinite concrete food trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that any provided food, not a special object, becomes the concrete trigger for Joseph’s sign.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as the subject of the negated arrival verb, and the CRITICAL rows read the indefiniteness under negation broadly.

topics.headline: food as sign-bearing provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that interpretation is grounded in ordinary bodily provision before the speech becomes theological.
topics.reason: The semantic and intertextual rows treat food as the temporal marker for knowledge rather than background detail.

words.gloss_range: passive provision to the two addressees with the meal resumed by suffix
words.root_gloss_range: provision/allotment root; here received provision is foregrounded while the giver is grammatically unstated
words.prose: {{ar:تُرْزَقَانِهِ}} ({{tr:turzaqānihī}}) describes the meal as something the two are provided with, not something they control. The passive leaves the giver unstated while the suffix ties the verb back to the food. Its unusual dual passive shape makes the provision individually calibrated to the two prisoners. That grammar lets the later claim about Joseph’s Lord supply the theological source without forcing it too early.

topics.headline: passive provision knot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word packs passive provision, the two recipients, and the food referent into one form.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect passive dual with object suffix, matching the pronominal binding rows.

topics.headline: divine provision field primed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive provision wording primes divine agency, while the local grammar leaves the giver unstated until Joseph names his Lord.
topics.reason: The passive deagentivizes the giver; later source-language supports the theological reading without making this word alone name the agent.

topics.headline: rare dual passive form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unusual dual passive shape as a focused form worth retaining for lexical review.
topics.reason: The row is form-specific and consistent with the QAC passive-dual analysis.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that makes Joseph’s disclosure the sole permitted condition
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that turns the negation into restriction. Food arrival is allowed only in one circumstance: Joseph will have already disclosed its interpretation. A small particle therefore carries the logical architecture of the opening proof.

topics.headline: exception hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception particle makes Joseph’s informing the sole allowed condition for arrival.
topics.reason: QAC marks an exception particle completing the negation-exception construction.

words.gloss_range: weighty informing promised as certain before the event arrives
words.root_gloss_range: news/informing root; here Form II marks authoritative disclosure, not merely casual notification
words.prose: {{ar:نَبَّأْتُكُمَا}} ({{tr:nabbaʾtukumā}}) presents Joseph’s promised informing as certain and weighty. The perfect form sits inside a future condition, making the disclosure feel fixed before the event occurs. Form II and the dual object suffix make the act both authoritative and specifically addressed to the two prisoners. The verb answers their request to be informed (12:36) by turning it into Joseph’s first-person commitment in 12:37, and the object of disclosure is interpretation rather than merely the fact that food will arrive.

topics.headline: certain authoritative informing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s disclosure is cast as fixed and weighty before the future event.
topics.reason: The perfect Form II verb with dual object suffix sits inside the future-oriented exception frame.

topics.headline: informing about taʾwīl
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph promises interpretation, not merely notification that food will arrive.
topics.reason: The verb takes the two recipients and a bi-governed interpretive content phrase.

topics.headline: request becomes promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prisoners’ request from 12:36 becoming Joseph’s first-person commitment in 12:37.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows explicitly connect 12:36, 12:37, and 12:45 around n-b-ʾ plus taʾwīl.

words.gloss_range: preposition linking informing to interpretive content
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) binds the informing to interpretive content. Joseph is not simply saying that food will arrive; he informs them about its taʾwīl. The preposition keeps the claim hermeneutic rather than a bare forecast.

topics.headline: preposition binds disclosure to content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small preposition keeps the claim about interpretation rather than bare prediction.
topics.reason: QAC marks bi as governing the following taʾwīl noun.

words.gloss_range: interpretation/outcome attached by suffix to the food event
words.root_gloss_range: return/interpretive-outcome root; here the range includes explanation and realized outcome without detaching from the local referent
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْوِيلِهِ}} ({{tr:taʾwīlihi}}) names the meaning or outcome Joseph will disclose before the event arrives. Its suffix ties the interpretation to the food-event, broadening the earlier prison request from dream interpretation to the significance of provision itself. The word belongs to the surah’s taʾwīl spine, from the early promise of taught interpretation (12:6) through the prison request and later recall (12:36, 12:45) to final fulfillment (12:100-101). The root’s return-to-origin pressure makes interpretation a tracing back to source and forward to fulfillment.

topics.headline: taʾwīl attached to food-event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same taʾwīl phrase expands from dream matter to the meaning of a coming provision-event.
topics.reason: The suffix is locally attached to the food-event, and the rows contrast the earlier prison request.

topics.headline: return-to-outcome semantics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that interpretation is not arbitrary explanation but a tracing of the event to source and outcome.
topics.reason: The lexical rows preserve the ʾ-w-l return/outcome range while QAC confirms the local gerund form.

topics.headline: surah taʾwīl spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this word as part of the surah’s major taʾwīl arc from 12:6 through 12:101.
topics.reason: The intertextual rows give concrete same-surah references for the recurring interpretation vocabulary.

words.gloss_range: anterior temporal marker requiring disclosure before arrival
words.root_gloss_range: facing/before/receiving root; here the temporal-before branch governs the deadline clause
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلَ}} ({{tr:qabla}}) makes timing the proof. Joseph’s disclosure must stand before the arrival, not after it as clever explanation. The word faces the coming event and sets a firm deadline that links interpretation to foreknowledge. Its before-arrival pattern also matches wider advance-disclosure language, such as warning before a day comes (14:31).

topics.headline: strict before-arrival deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s proof depends on interpretation preceding the event, not following it.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a temporal adverb governing the following clause.

topics.headline: before-it-comes formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the before-arrival wording belongs to a wider Quranic pattern of advance disclosure and warning.
topics.reason: The rows cite qabl with arrival language in 14:31 and other same-surah uses.

words.gloss_range: subordinator that makes the arrival clause dependent on the temporal marker
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) subordinates the second arrival verb to the temporal marker. Its small grammatical role matters because it turns the coming of food into a dependent deadline clause, not a fresh independent event.

topics.headline: subordinated arrival deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming event is grammatically dependent on the before marker.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as triggering subjunctive mood in the following verb.

words.gloss_range: second arrival verb under subjunctive mood, closing the before-arrival deadline
words.root_gloss_range: coming/arrival root; here the same event-root is grammatically recast as the temporal limit
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيَكُمَا}} ({{tr:yaʾtiyakumā}}) repeats the arrival root but under subjunctive control after the subordinator. That mood shift separates the first negated arrival frame from the later before-arrival limit. The repeated dual suffix keeps the same two listeners inside both halves of the proof.

topics.headline: arrival reprise under mood shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated arrival root shifted from negated frame to temporal deadline.
topics.reason: QAC marks the second arrival verb as subjunctive after the subordinator, with the same dual suffix.

topics.headline: deadline closes first movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening proof closes by making retrospective interpretation structurally impossible.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows read the before-arrival clause as the closure of the prediction frame.

words.gloss_range: dual-address demonstrative summarizing the proof before naming its source
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكُمَا}} ({{tr:dhālikumā}}) points back to the demonstrated ability and turns it into evidence. The dual ending keeps the claim addressed to the two prisoners who can test it. Joseph then redirects attention from his skill to its source.

topics.headline: demonstrated ability redirected to source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Joseph turning the proof just offered into an attribution of divine source.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is the subject of a nominal sentence whose predicate is the source phrase.

topics.headline: dual demonstrative address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both prisoners are personally included as witnesses of the claim.
topics.reason: The suffix on the demonstrative keeps the two addressees in view.

words.gloss_range: partitive-source phrase: from what Joseph’s Lord taught him
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) makes the source claim partitive: this disclosure is from what Joseph’s Lord taught him. The phrase grounds his knowledge in divine teaching while refusing the shape of an omniscience claim. It keeps authority and limitation together.

topics.headline: partitive divine-source hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph claims taught knowledge from God while limiting the scope to what he was taught.
topics.reason: QAC marks fused min plus relative element, and the CRITICAL rows support a partitive/source reading.

words.gloss_range: divine teaching verb with Joseph as recipient
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge/teaching root; here Form II marks deliberate imparted knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَّمَنِي}} ({{tr:ʿallamanī}}) identifies Joseph as the taught recipient, not the independent owner of interpretation. Form II presents teaching as deliberate transmission, and the first-person suffix marks him as the one who received it. The word is the epistemic hinge between the proof and the creed declaration, and it realizes the earlier promise that Joseph would be taught interpretation (12:6, 12:21).

topics.headline: Joseph as taught recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s interpretive authority is explained as received teaching, not autonomous genius.
topics.reason: The verb’s valency marks Joseph as recipient and the source phrase identifies his Lord as teacher.

topics.headline: deliberate Form II teaching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form’s active transmission of knowledge, not accidental knowing.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form II, matching rows about deliberate teaching.

topics.headline: same-surah divine teaching realization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 12:37 as the prison realization of the earlier promise that Joseph would be taught taʾwīl (12:6, 12:21).
topics.reason: The rows cite 12:6 and 12:21 as earlier statements of the teaching motif.

words.gloss_range: personal Lord as the agent/source of Joseph’s teaching
words.root_gloss_range: lordship/cultivation root; here the possessive divine title stresses personal nurture and authority
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّي}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) names the agent of teaching as Joseph’s personal Lord. The possessive form makes the source relational without making the knowledge private invention. It continues Joseph’s first-person Lord thread from prayer to answer and teaching (12:33, 12:34, 12:37). Its lordly nurture frame contrasts with the later public failure to believe in God.

topics.headline: personal Lord as knowledge source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph names his source relationally as his Lord, fitting the teaching context.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as the agent of teaching with first-person possessive suffix.

topics.headline: Joseph’s rabbī thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prison knowledge claim as part of Joseph’s recurring first-person dependence on his Lord (12:33, 12:34, 12:37).
topics.reason: The same-surah rows connect Joseph’s prayer and divine response to this source phrase.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person frame for Joseph’s creed declaration
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّي}} ({{tr:innī}}) gives Joseph’s turn to creed the force of a solemn self-declaration. The interpretation scene is no longer only a service to the prisoners; it becomes a statement of who he is and where he stands.

topics.headline: emphatic self-positioning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech pivot from proof of knowledge to Joseph’s declared identity boundary.
topics.reason: QAC marks an emphatic particle with first-person suffix introducing the following declaration.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person abandonment of a creed object
words.root_gloss_range: leaving/abandoning root; here a deliberate theological and communal disaffiliation is active
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَكْتُ}} ({{tr:taraktu}}) casts Joseph’s separation as a completed act of leaving. He does not merely disagree with a people’s creed; he says he has abandoned it. The first-person perfect makes the boundary personally owned and already settled. The leaving root is recast from other scenes of being left or refusing to leave, such as the brothers leaving Joseph (12:17) and ʿĀd refusing to abandon their gods (11:53), into chosen fidelity.

topics.headline: completed creed abandonment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Joseph’s creed separation as a completed social and theological act.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person verb takes millah as its object.

topics.headline: leaving recast within wider contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that leaving is recast from loss or refusal into chosen fidelity, with contrasts such as 12:17 and 11:53.
topics.reason: The intertextual rows provide concrete contrasts for the t-r-k root.

words.gloss_range: communal creed/path as the object Joseph leaves
words.root_gloss_range: creed/path noun; locally narrowed away from unrelated weariness branches
words.prose: {{ar:مِلَّةَ}} ({{tr:millata}}) makes the thing left a communal path of belief, not just a private opinion. Its construct relation with the people-term keeps creed and community bound together. The abandoned millah in 12:37 is answered immediately by the followed Abrahamic millah in 12:38. The local sense is prescribed communal way, while unrelated weariness branches remain outside the active reading.

topics.headline: communal creed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph leaves a communal creed defined by unbelief, not merely a set of private ideas.
topics.reason: QAC marks millah as the object of taraktu in construct with qawmin.

topics.headline: abandoned millah versus followed millah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 12:37’s abandoned millah is answered immediately by 12:38’s followed Abrahamic millah.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly cite the adjacent contrast between 12:37 and 12:38.

topics.headline: millah branch caution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local sense is prescribed communal way, while other m-l-l branches remain lexical background rather than the active meaning.
topics.reason: The object of taraktu and construct with qawmin constrain the sense to creed/path.

words.gloss_range: indefinite collective people defined by unbelief
words.root_gloss_range: standing/people root; here the collective community sense is active, with uprightness only as limited resonance
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) leaves the group indefinite and defines it by what follows. Joseph is not merely naming an ethnicity; he identifies a type of community by disbelief. The collective noun lets one creed-bearing body stand for its members, contrasting with other qawm trajectories such as the brothers’ hoped-for righteous group (12:9) and Jacob’s later disbelieving group label (12:87).

topics.headline: indefinite collective people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejected group is typological and defined by unbelief rather than by a proper name.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite genitive collective noun after millah.

topics.headline: community defined by unbelief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people-term becomes creed-bearing because the following clause defines them.
topics.reason: The relative/descriptive clause supplies the group’s defining theological trait.

topics.headline: same-surah qawm contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Yusuf’s rejected qawm set against other communal trajectories in the surah (12:9, 12:87).
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete same-surah qawm contrasts.

words.gloss_range: negative particle defining the people by ongoing non-belief
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) supplies the negative mark inside that community description. It makes unbelief the defining feature of the people whose creed Joseph left. This second negation shifts the ayah from no food arriving without disclosure to a people who do not believe.

topics.headline: negative marker of creed description
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people’s creed is defined first by ongoing non-belief.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the following imperfect faith verb.

words.gloss_range: negated habitual faith verb aimed at God
words.root_gloss_range: security/trust/faith root; here Form IV faith is negated as an ongoing communal stance
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) is the faith verb under habitual negation. The accusation is not a single lapse but an ongoing stance toward God, and the plural form distributes that stance across the people. The final predicate will sharpen this absence of faith into named disbelief. The same faith root also belongs to the surah’s wider diagnosis, from the brothers’ claim that Jacob will not believe them (12:17) to the later mixed-belief verdict (12:106).

topics.headline: habitual non-belief toward God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is an ongoing failure of trust/security toward God.
topics.reason: The imperfect faith verb is negated by lā and takes a bi complement.

topics.headline: faith-disbelief escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s closing move from negated faith to explicit disbelief.
topics.reason: The rows link the faith verb with the final k-f-r predicate.

topics.headline: same-surah faith diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Joseph’s prison statement inside the surah’s broader belief and unbelief diagnosis (12:17, 12:106).
topics.reason: The intertextual rows cite same-surah recurrence of the faith root.

words.gloss_range: preposition specifying the object of belief as God
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) gives the faith verb its object. The failure is specifically belief in God, not a vague lack of piety. It also prepares the parallel prepositional frame that will mark their stance toward the Hereafter.

topics.headline: faith complement marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is specifically belief in God and is paired with the Hereafter complement.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as governing the divine name after the faith verb.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the complement of failed belief
words.root_gloss_range: divinity/name root field; here the proper name functions as the definite personal object of faith, with etymology left cautious
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) makes the failure of faith direct and definite. Joseph has just spoken of his personal Lord as teacher; here the public divine name becomes the object the people fail to believe in. The proper-name form keeps the charge from dissolving into abstract religiosity. It also anticipates Joseph’s explicit monotheistic argument about God in 12:39 and divine authority in 12:40.

topics.headline: proper divine-name complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of failed belief is the definite proper divine name, while root etymology does not override the syntax.
topics.reason: QAC marks a proper noun governed by bi, and the lexical-caution row is preserved as scope control.

topics.headline: from personal Lord to public God-name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from Joseph’s personal Lord as teacher to God as the public object of communal faith.
topics.reason: The source phrase and the belief complement create the title contrast.

topics.headline: formulaic God-belief diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph’s prison speech already opens the monotheistic argument developed in 12:39 and 12:40.
topics.reason: The rows cite the formula across 6:148, 10:99, 12:106 and later same-surah argument.

words.gloss_range: conjunction or circumstantial link into the closing Hereafter-disbelief clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the indictment into its closing clause. It can be heard both as adding a second charge and as describing the state in which their unbelief stands. The connective gives the final verdict a fresh start without detaching it from the faith failure before it.

topics.headline: linked final charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial of God and denial of the Hereafter are joined rather than separate accusations.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction introducing the final elaborating clause.

topics.headline: closing verdict cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause as a memorable condemnation cadence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows read the connector as launching a tadhyīl-like closure.

words.gloss_range: explicit pronoun subject restarting focus on the same people
words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) reintroduces the same group before the Hereafter clause. The pronoun foregrounds them as the subject of the final identity statement and keeps the people described by qawmin in view. Its repetition with the later pronoun intensifies the closing judgment.

topics.headline: pronoun foregrounds same people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same qawm being reintroduced as the subject of the final identity verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks the pronoun as subject of the final nominal sentence.

topics.headline: local pronoun doubling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the doubled pronoun pattern intensifying the closing judgment.
topics.reason: The local rows tie this pronoun to the later separating pronoun.

words.gloss_range: fronted preposition marking the Hereafter as the domain of disbelief
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) begins a fronted complement, placing the Hereafter before the predicate. The syntax makes the domain of disbelief prominent before the label arrives. It also mirrors the earlier belief-in-God complement with a second theological object.

topics.headline: fronted Hereafter complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Hereafter placed first as the focal domain of disbelief.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as fronted before the predicate.

topics.headline: paired prepositional theology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same prepositional relation helping pair faith in God with disbelief regarding the Hereafter.
topics.reason: The row directly compares the faith and disbelief complement frames.

words.gloss_range: definite Hereafter as fronted eschatological object-domain
words.root_gloss_range: later/final root; here the lexical range is narrowed to the known eschatological realm
words.prose: {{ar:الْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) names the known final realm as the focal domain of disbelief. The definite form turns later-ness into a doctrinal object, not an indefinite future event. In the fronted phrase, Joseph’s charge joins failure toward God with denial of final accountability. The closing Hereafter-disbelief wording echoes a recognized formula, including the exact pattern in 11:19.

topics.headline: definite eschatological object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Hereafter as a known final realm foregrounded before the predicate.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite noun governed by a fronted preposition.

topics.headline: God and Hereafter paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Joseph’s indictment running on two axes: failure toward God and denial of final accountability.
topics.reason: The rows interlock the divine-name complement with the Hereafter-disbelief clause.

topics.headline: recognized Hereafter-disbelief formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause echoes a wider Quranic condemnation formula, including the exact phrase in 11:19.
topics.reason: The intertextual rows cite concrete formula occurrences.

words.gloss_range: separating focus pronoun before the final predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) functions as the focus pronoun before the predicate. After the Hereafter phrase has been fronted, this pronoun sharpens the statement into an emphatic identity verdict. The doubled hum pattern gives the clause its concentrated force.

topics.headline: separating focus pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause means more than simple disbelief; it sharpens them as the ones characterized by that denial.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the pronoun as damīr al-faṣl before the predicate.

topics.headline: doubled hum force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated hum pattern tightening the final verdict.
topics.reason: The rows preserve local repetition and cadence as part of the closing emphasis.

words.prose: {{ar:كَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}) closes the ayah with a plural participial identity label. The wording escalates from “they do not believe” to “they are disbelievers,” making the verdict stable rather than momentary. The label is bound to the fronted Hereafter complement and participates in the exact condemnation pattern also found in 11:19. The root’s covering and ingratitude pressures remain visible inside the selected theological sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled يَأْتِيكُمَا encloses طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ and places نَبَّأْتُكُمَا before the second arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: An allocated item of subsistence is on its way, while the speaker claims an informational lead over its arrival. On the most local reading, he can identify or account for each meal before it reaches the two hearers.

activation_trace.role: The repeated arrival supplies the event whose timing brackets the claim.
Tasting and eating keep the immediate object concretely meal-like.
The livelihood branch widens the meal into provisioned subsistence.
Allocated giving marks the food as a received share rather than a self-produced object.
A report that reaches its hearers supplies the advance disclosure.
Precedence gives the report a measurable lead over the arriving meal.

changed_reading.before: The sentence is a general assertion of interpretive ability.
changed_reading.after: The sentence first presents a concrete prison-scale test: an allotted meal cannot arrive without the speaker's report getting there first.

baseline_models.mechanism: The return-to-outcome branch of تَأْوِيل makes the promise larger than naming a menu. The speaker claims to state where an arriving matter tends or terminates while that matter is still approaching, so explanation is prospective rather than retrospective.

activation_trace.role: The delivered report gives the model its communicative act.
Return to a final outcome makes interpretation an account of what the matter becomes.
Temporal priority places that outcome-account before manifestation.
The avenue and readiness of an event supply a process that can be read before completion.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation explains an opaque sign after it has been presented.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation is advance access to a matter's trajectory: its ending can become reportable before its event becomes present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّى إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ ... وَهُم ... كَافِرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse places received knowledge beside departure from a communal creed. It does not explicitly state a causal equation, but it presents interpretive authority as accountable to a Lord and as incompatible with a social path that withholds assent and covers truth.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the claimed epistemic gift.
Knowledge attributed to the Lord identifies the source to which the method answers.
Deliberate release from something supplies the negative act of epistemic separation.
A followed creed supplies the inherited system from which the speaker separates.
Settled assent supplies the positive epistemic relation that the group lacks.
Obstruction of truth supplies the failure against which the claimed teaching is positioned.

changed_reading.before: The creed statement is a digression after a claim of special knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The creed statement is part of the credential: how one receives and reports outcomes is tied to which authority and communal path one refuses or trusts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair of dream reports explicitly asks for an interpretation, and one dream already contains carried bread being eaten. This reopens the focus sentence: its food can remain a literal meal forecast, but it can also function as a compact demonstration that the requested dream-food has an outcome knowable before enactment.

activation_trace.role: Concrete food keeps the local antecedent of the pronoun alive.
Return to outcome lets the same wording reach beyond a menu to a dream's realized end.
Repeated dream-vision supplies the symbolic container to which an outcome-reading can answer.
The request for a delivered report anticipates the focus speaker's promise to report.
The explicit request for an outcome-return supplies the discourse-level referent of the focus claim.
Consumption turns the carried bread from a static image into a future event-chain.

structural_cues: 12:36 contains two first-person visions and ends with an explicit request using the same report-and-interpretation construction that 12:37 answers.
The food imagery is split across the literal meal in 12:37 and dream bread in 12:36, so neither antecedent should be forced to eliminate the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent request, the repeated report/interpretation roots, and dream food; I infer that the meal claim demonstrates command of dream outcomes. A live alternative is a literal prediction of prison meals inserted before any dream explanation.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun in بِتَأْوِيلِهِ points only to the arriving food.
changed_reading.after: The pronoun remains locally food-linked while the preceding request activates a second reading: food is also the test case through which dream interpretation proves it can outrun fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts an inherited path, scattered lords, and self-assigned names lacking compelling warrant with one source of judgment and accurate knowledge. On this reading, تَأْوِيل is anti-nominal: it does not merely attach labels to signs but returns them to coherent consequences under an accountable authority.

activation_trace.role: Known disclosure supplies the positive alternative to unsupported naming.
Lord-derived knowledge gives interpretation an accountable source.
Following in another's track supplies the mechanism of inherited epistemic continuity.
A creed that is followed supplies the positive counterpart to the creed left in the focus.
Dispersion into pieces supplies the rival model of fragmented authority.
Unshared divine unity supplies the single authority under which disparate signs can cohere.
Names as markers supply the possibility of designation without explanatory purchase.
Compelling warrant supplies the criterion that the invented names lack.
Knowledge that lands correctly supplies the standard for a consequential interpretation.

structural_cues: 12:38 answers تركت with اتبعت, making departure and following paired epistemic motions.
12:39-40 move from scattered masters to one God and then from invented names to judgment, authority, and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited following, fragmented versus unitary authority, unsupported naming, and judgment; I infer that this sequence also describes what separates valid interpretation from arbitrary labeling. It may instead be an independent exhortation placed before, but not methodologically tied to, the dream answer.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's monotheistic declaration establishes only his religious identity.
changed_reading.after: The declaration also proposes an epistemic ethic: a true interpretation must do more than name signs, because it is answerable to coherent outcomes and warranted judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two requested answers become mutually exclusive embodied futures, and the sequence closes by declaring the matter completed. This strengthens تَأْوِيل as disclosure of an outcome that will take effect, not a detachable symbolic gloss.

activation_trace.role: The matter's return to its endpoint supplies the semantic core that the later fates enact.
A requested decisive answer frames interpretation as a determination sought from the speaker.
Actual eating carries the earlier food image into an embodied terminal event.
Completion and exhaustion of the matter close off a merely tentative reading.

structural_cues: 12:41 resolves the paired dreamers with an أما ... وأما distribution and then closes with قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two enacted fates and a completion formula; I infer that this realization clarifies the force of تَأْوِيل in 12:37. The completion formula could refer only to the decree about these two men rather than define interpretation generally.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation is an informative account that may remain separate from what follows.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation exposes the event's binding endpoint; the explanation is verified when the image becomes a lived fate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after proving advance knowledge, the speaker tries to use human remembrance to alter his own confinement, but forgetting intervenes and he remains. The sequence blocks an inflation of the focus claim: knowing an arrival before it occurs does not entail causing, accelerating, or controlling one's desired arrival.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the temporal event over which the speaker claims knowledge but not explicit control.
Informational precedence is the limited capacity being tested.
Recall supplies the proposed human relay from prison knowledge to release.
Loss of remembrance breaks the proposed relay.
Continued residence supplies the prolonged result of that broken relay.

structural_cues: The command ٱذْكُرْنِى is followed by forgetting and then by a quantified multi-year stay in prison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies foreknowledge, an attempted remembrance relay, its failure, and prolonged confinement; I infer a boundary between epistemic access and schedule control. The delay can also be read simply as plot causation, without qualifying the earlier claim.

changed_reading.before: Advance knowledge suggests broad mastery over coming events.
changed_reading.after: Advance knowledge is real but bounded: the speaker can disclose another's outcome while remaining unable to hasten his own transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The royal vision is converted into a timed chain of cultivation, restrained consumption, protected storage, severe depletion, relief, and renewed extraction. This activates the focus cluster of food, allotted provision, advance outcome, and Lord-taught knowledge as a control system: interpretation creates lead time in which future scarcity can be survived.

activation_trace.role: Food as livelihood supplies the population-scale resource being governed.
An allotted share supplies the distributive dimension of future provisioning.
Taking charge of an affair activates the packet's split-root possibility that interpretation includes governance.
A royal dream supplies the compressed forecast that must be unfolded into action.
Cultivation and growth begin the planned resource cycle.
Leaving grain in place supplies deliberate non-consumption as preservation.
Protection within an enclosure supplies reserve security against the consuming years.
Relief of the afflicted supplies the reversal after scarcity.
Extracted yield supplies renewed productive abundance at the end of the cycle.

structural_cues: 12:43-49 turns sevenfold dream images into an ordered multi-year program rather than stopping at prediction.
The program explicitly controls how much is eaten, what remains protected, what future years consume, and when relief resumes production.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forecast and every stage of the agricultural sequence; I infer the directional arrow that interpretation functions as anticipatory governance. A live alternative is that prophecy and practical advice are adjacent but conceptually separable acts.

changed_reading.before: Knowing food before it arrives is a private sign of extraordinary perception.
changed_reading.after: Knowing provision ahead of arrival is socially operative lead time: the interpretation becomes a storage and rationing policy that preserves a population.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the king orders the speaker brought, the summons does not produce immediate arrival. He returns the messenger, demands inquiry, and waits for truth to emerge. The focus formula of report-before-arrival is thus reenacted procedurally: a verified account must reach the court before the interpreter himself does.

activation_trace.role: A report reaching another party supplies the informational object that can precede transfer.
Precedence supplies the procedural ordering later applied to the speaker's own arrival.
The king's command to bring him makes the interpreter's physical arrival the pending event.
Sending the messenger back interrupts immediate transfer and creates an investigative interval.
Questioning supplies the inquiry through which the prior report is produced.
Truth emerging into visibility supplies the report's public arrival.
Established and displayed truth supplies the verified content required before movement.

structural_cues: The command ٱئْتُونِى بِهِ is suspended by ٱرْجِعْ ... فَسْـَٔلْهُ, and the inquiry concludes with ٱلْـَٰٔنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons, a returned messenger, an inquiry, and public truth; I infer that their order reenacts the focus's report-before-arrival pattern. A live alternative is that the delay serves personal exoneration alone and does not generalize into an interpretive ethic.

changed_reading.before: Before-arrival knowledge is only a claim about external events or meals.
changed_reading.after: Before-arrival knowledge becomes a practiced procedure: verified meaning should arrive before the person, office, or consequence built upon it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby discourse joins knowledge to fidelity when unobserved, then refuses simple self-acquittal and admits an internally commanding self except where mercy intervenes. This revises the focus credential: leaving a truth-covering creed does not make the knower self-validating; trustworthy interpretation also requires fidelity under absence and suspicion toward one's own motives.

activation_trace.role: Claimed disclosure supplies the knowledge whose ethical conditions are being qualified.
Blocking truth supplies the external failure that cannot by itself certify the one who rejects it.
Deficient fidelity supplies the ethical corruption opposed to reliable reporting.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the condition under which fidelity cannot depend on observation.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies a path that treacherous plotting fails to reach.
Disavowal of complete innocence blocks self-certification.
The inward faculty of judgment supplies a possible source of distortion inside the knower.
Merciful tenderness supplies the exception that prevents the self's pressure from being absolute.

structural_cues: 12:52-53 moves from truth known under absence to non-acquittal of the self, internal pressure toward wrong, and mercy.
The packet does not mark a speaker change across these statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fidelity in absence, failed guidance of betrayal, non-acquittal, an inward command, and mercy; I infer that they qualify the focus claim of Lord-taught knowledge. A materially live alternative is that 12:52-53 changes speaker, making this a contextual ethical frame rather than the interpreter's own self-qualification.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting the unbelieving creed and citing divine teaching are sufficient self-credentials.
changed_reading.after: The credential remains accountable and non-triumphal: truth must be kept when unseen, while the interpreter's own inward judgment remains subject to suspicion and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interpreter is selected, empowered, called trustworthy, and then claims fitness over the storehouses through the paired capacities of guarding and knowing. This strongly activates the split mapping of تَأْوِيل toward taking charge: advance understanding of provision matures into accountable custody of the material system it disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the exploratory governance dimension of interpretation.
Livelihood supplies the material domain that later comes under custody.
Disclosed knowledge supplies one half of the later administrative qualification.
Selection into exclusive service moves the interpreter from confinement toward office.
Empowerment supplies the capacity to implement rather than merely announce.
Settled trust supplies the social authorization required for custody.
The keeper responsible for preservation supplies the concrete office.
Active guarding supplies the operational complement to foresight.
Knowledge reappears as an explicit qualification for administering the stores.

structural_cues: 12:54 pairs مَكِينٌ with أَمِينٌ; 12:55 then pairs حَفِيظٌ with عَلِيمٌ over the storehouses.
12:56 narrates actual establishment in the land, confirming that the requested capacity becomes operative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, empowerment, trust, storehouses, guarding, and knowledge; I infer that these realize a governance potential in the split-root inventory of تَأْوِيل. The conservative alternative keeps interpretation and later administration distinct, with only narrative qualification linking them.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation is a verbal gift displayed to two prisoners.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation is the first form of custodianship: accurate anticipation of provision qualifies the knower to guard, allocate, and administer it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context returns explicitly to the afterlife, belief, protective conduct, and a better reward. It places the focus's rapid knowledge-before-arrival claim inside a second temporal scale: immediate provision can be forecast and managed, but ultimate value belongs to a later recompense.

activation_trace.role: Near precedence supplies the short horizon of advance knowledge.
What comes after the first horizon supplies the ultimate temporal frame already named in the focus.
Settled assent links that later horizon to the focus's contrast in belief.
Recompense for action supplies the value realized beyond immediate subsistence.
The later realm explicitly reactivates the focus's long horizon.
Believing assent identifies those oriented to the later reward.
Placing oneself under protection supplies sustained conduct between present provision and final recompense.

structural_cues: 12:57 closes the packet window by repeating both afterlife and belief from the focus while adding reward and protective conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a short before-arrival interval and a closing later-reward interval; I infer a nested temporal model in which logistical foresight remains subordinate to eschatological valuation. The closing line may instead function as a general coda without specifically reframing 12:37.

changed_reading.before: The verse's temporal interest is exhausted by predicting what arrives next.
changed_reading.after: The verse holds two clocks together: near provision can be known and managed ahead of time, while the worth of belief and conduct is disclosed on the farther horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from focus ق و ل to ق ل ل and should not be treated as the lexical meaning of قَالَ. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated when the later plan twice says only a little may be eaten or retained. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root resonance: the speaker's saying becomes effective as calibrated scarcity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ at the opening of 12:37, resolved through the packet's secondary ق ل ل target.

activation_trace.role: The secondary fewness branch lets the opening speech carry an exploratory resonance of measured limitation.
The first explicit small remainder turns interpretation into a rule limiting present consumption.
The second small remainder confirms scarcity as the practical register of the earlier saying.

changed_reading.before: قَالَ merely introduces a speech about interpretation.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's split-root edge, the speech itself becomes a measure: its truth is operationalized by saying how little may be consumed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the agricultural branch of ك ف ر is distant from the ordinary force of كَافِرُونَ. It remains valid as a contrast because the branch is focus-anchored and the later context supplies cultivation plus protected grain. Downstream prose should not redefine unbelief as farming; it should qualify the activation as a distinction between destructive concealment of truth and protective covering that preserves future life.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَافِرُونَ in 12:37, carrying both truth-obstruction and the packet's seed-covering branch.

activation_trace.role: Obstruction of truth supplies the culpable kind of covering named in the focus.
Covering seed supplies a materially productive counter-image within the same focus inventory.
Cultivation supplies the scene in which hidden seed can generate rather than suppress life.
Leaving grain in its protective setting supplies deliberate concealment for future use.
Enclosed preservation supplies the protective counterpart to truth-obstructing concealment.

changed_reading.before: Covering is a uniformly negative image for refusal of truth.
changed_reading.after: The agricultural context differentiates coverings by function: covering truth blocks life-giving knowledge, while covering and enclosing seed can preserve life through a future crisis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مِلَّة in the sentence straightforwardly denotes a creed, while the hot-ash branch is materially remote. It remains packet-anchored, and the immediately preceding dream supplies bread and eating that can activate that dormant image. Downstream prose should retain creed as the translation and mention hot ash only as a contained material analogy for a social medium that turns and forms what passes through it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِلَّةَ in the departure clause of 12:37, with its creed branch primary and hot-ash branch latent.

activation_trace.role: The followed creed supplies the explicit social and religious referent.
Hot material in which bread is turned supplies the dormant formative analogy.
Bread in the adjacent dream activates the otherwise remote cooking image.
Consumption makes the formed product consequential rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Leaving a creed means only changing stated affiliation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, leaving a creed is exiting a formative heat-bed that turns what a community produces and consumes, before offering a differently sourced nourishment.

strongest_changes: The literal meal forecast remains live, but 12:36 and 12:41 turn it into a second reading in which dream images disclose embodied outcomes before fulfillment.
12:43-49 transforms interpretation from private foreknowledge into anticipatory famine governance through cultivation, restraint, storage, relief, and renewed yield.
12:50-51 reenacts report-before-arrival as a procedure: verified truth reaches authority before the interpreter accepts transfer.
12:54-56 joins knowledge to trust, guarding, and storehouse office, activating تَأْوِيل as custodial implementation as well as explanation.
12:42 prevents overreach by separating advance knowledge from control over the timing of one's own release.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse latent-links food, provision, outcome, precedence, teaching, creed, belief, and covering. The context does not resolve these into one thesis: it successively activates dream fulfillment, anti-nominal authority, logistical planning, procedural truth, ethical self-suspicion, administrative custody, and a farther afterlife clock.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and scope of بِتَأْوِيلِهِ remain productively double: literal arriving food and the requested dream matter both retain syntactic or discourse support.
The packet does not settle speaker continuity in 12:52-53, so ethical self-qualification may be direct speech or a contextual frame.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل, ك ف ر seed-covering, and م ل ل hot-ash activations are packet-resolved but deliberately exploratory; none should displace the primary lexical readings.
The governance sense activated through the non-dominant و ل ي target may describe what interpretation becomes in the narrative rather than what تَأْوِيل itself lexically means.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Interpretive knowledge precedes incoming provision.** ء ت ي B001, ط ع م B004 (provision/livelihood), ر ز ق B001, ن ب ء B002, ء و ل B002, and ق ب ل B002 (priorness) form an anticipation mechanism. I infer that ordinary recurring food serves as a near-term verification field for the claimed gift. Interpretation reads as timely disclosure before arrival.
2. **Leaving a covered way is epistemically productive.** ت ر ك B001, م ل ل B003 (professed religious way), ء م ن B002, and ك ف ر B003 (covering/rejecting truth) precede `علمني ربي`. I infer that abandoning a truth-covering framework is part of becoming teachable. The ayah links allegiance and knowledge without reducing one to the other.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:41 immediately demonstrated the promised prior disclosure, and 12:43-49 expanded the same gift from private food timing to national provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Provision as a timed threshold for disclosure.** `ر ز ق:B002` is nourishing food, while `ر ز ق:B001` is provision as an allotted gift. Joseph makes the arrival of allotted food the deadline before which he will report its interpretation, then calls his knowledge something taught by his Lord; 12:38-40 turns the interval into instruction before 12:41 answers the dreams. The packet supplies food, timing, teaching, and answer; I infer that material provision opens a bounded pedagogical occasion. The ayah reads as coordinating nourishment and knowledge without collapsing one into the other.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:88 brings the brothers back under distress to request measure, showing that provision is not only a teaching threshold here but eventually the social medium through which the family is gathered.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.
يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.branch_image_ar: قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.

Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iyi geçim içinde olma, rızkı açık olma, insanlara bolca yiyecek sunma ve gelir sağlayan pay ya da mülk anlamlarını ortak geçim alanında toplar. Yeme eylemi bu dalın özü değil, geçimin sağladığı maddi dayanağın arka planıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın nitelemeler iyi durum, rızık ve bol ikramı; kalıplaşmış kullanımlar ise kazancın niteliğini ve bir yerin gelir kaynağı olarak tahsisini gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin geçim ve kazanç bakımından iyi durumda veya payına düşen gelir bakımından talihli olması; ayrıca bol yiyecek sunması ya da bir gelir kaynağının birine geçim payı olarak ayrılması.

facets.statement: Geçim, kazanç veya gelir bakımından iyi ve elverişli durumda olma.
İnsanlara ve konuklara sıkça, bolca yiyecek sunan kişi olma.
Bir kazanç yolu, arazi geliri, vergi payı veya kamu gelirinin birine geçim kaynağı olarak ayrılması.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, çekirdeği yararlanılacak bir payın verilmesi olarak kurar; ilk taslakta öne çıkan zamanlı verme, sürekli verilen payları da kapsayacak biçimde genişletilir. lexicalization_scope.note: Çekirdek anlam yalın biçimlerde geçerlidir; bilgi verilmesini anlatan kullanım ise yalnız kanıttaki söz dizimiyle sınırlı bir gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir alıcıya yararlanması için maddi veya manevi bir payın verilmesi, ayrılması ya da ulaşmasının sağlanmasıdır. Pay belirli bir zamanda verilebildiği gibi süreklilik de gösterebilir.

Belirli zamanda verilen paydan düzenli ya da süren yardıma doğru kapsam genişleyebilir.
Verilen yarar mal, toplumsal konum veya bilgi gibi maddi ve manevi türlerde gerçekleşebilir.
Sağlayan adı, payı yaratanı, vereni veya alıcıya ulaşmasına aracılık edeni belirtebilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخروج من أرض إلى أرض، والمجيء من بلد آخر، والطلوع على القوم، وما جاءت به الأرض.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi haberi temel anlam olarak verir; bazı kullanımlarda haberin önemli ve bilgi sağlayıcı olmasını, ayrıca haber verme ile haber isteme eylemlerini aynı dalın biçimleri olarak belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım haber adını çekirdeğe alır; bildirme, belirli bir şeyi bildirme ve haber isteme biçimlerini bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir olay veya durum hakkında iletilen haber, özellikle bilgi ya da güçlü bir kanaat sağlayacak ölçüde önemli haber anlamıdır. Birine haber vermek, belirli bir şeyi bildirmek ve birinden haber istemek bu çekirdeğe bağlı eylemlerdir.

facets.statement: Bir olay veya durum hakkında başkasına ulaşan bilgi içerikli haber söz konusudur.
Haber, önemli bir yarar taşıyıp bilgi veya güçlü bir kanaat oluşturabilir.
Haber verme, bir şeyi bildirme ve karşı taraftan haber isteme eylemleri aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.
Haber verme biçimlerinden biri, başka bir bildirme biçimine göre daha güçlü anlatım sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tabanı haber ve haber vermedir. Toplu ifade ayrıca önemli haberin bilgi veya güçlü kanaat sağladığını, haber isteme biçimini ve iki bildirme biçimi arasında güç farkı bulunduğunu kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın haber çekirdeğini korur ve haberin bir olay ya da durum hakkında bilgi taşıdığını belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: İletilen içerik ile bu içeriğin haber niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İçeriğin yararlı olduğu ve bilgi ya da güçlü kanaat doğurduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin önemini ve alıcıda bilgi veya güçlü kanaat oluşturmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye olay veya durum hakkında bilgi iletme eylemi söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir haber içeriğini başka bir kişiye iletme eylemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin iç yüzünü sınayarak öğrenme, deneyim ve uzmanlık anlamları da kapsanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberi açıklayıp yayma ve onu geniş bir çevreye duyurma yönü belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir haber içeriğinin başkalarına ulaşmasını içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haberin kendisi ve onu başkasına bildirme eylemi temel kapsamdadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişide bulunan bilgiyi sınayarak araştırma ve haber soruşturma öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal haber isteme ve bilinmeyen bir içeriği öğrenme bağlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal araştırıp soruşturmayı çekirdek yapar; odak dalda haber isteme, haber ile bildirme çekirdeğine bağlı bir eylemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; haberin içeriği, iletilmesi ve istenmesi arasındaki sınırları en iyi gösteren üç aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النبأ بمعنى الخبر، والأنباء، ونبأته وأنبأته واستنبأته، والنبأ العظيم ذو الفائدة والعلم أو غلبة الظن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النبأ الخبر (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ نبأته وأنبأته واستنبأته والجميع الأنباء (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ خبر ذو فائدة عظيمة يحصل به علم أو غلبة ظن (mufradat)؛ نبأته أبلغ من أنبأته (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النبي أو النبئ لأنه ينبئ عن الله، والنبوة بوصفها سفارة بين الله وعباده، لا مطلق الخبر البشري.
يدخل فيه تنبأ فلان بمعنى ادعى النبوة كذبا، ونبيئ سوء فيمن ليست أخباره من أخبار الله.
يدخل فيه قولهم رمى فأنبأ إذا لم يشرم ولم يخدش، كأن السهم عدل عن الخدش وسقط في موضع آخر.
يدخل فيه النبأة بمعنى الصوت أو الصوت الخفي أو النغية، وما كان صوتا ليس بالشديد.
يدخل فيه النبي بمعنى الطريق الواضح الذي يأخذك إلى حيث تريد، وموضع النبي من الكاثب أي ما سهل من الأرض.

root_profile.summary: Kök, yerler arası geçiş ve yeni yerde belirme çevresinden haber iletmeye uzanan anlamların yanında Tanrı'dan haber veren elçi ve sahte elçilik iddiasını da taşır; ayrıca okun iz bırakmadan sapması, hafif belirsiz ses ve hedefe götüren açık yol gibi bağımsız dallara ayrılır.

başka bir yerden gelen ya da çıkan

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأول والأولى والأوائل والأولية وما يدل على ابتداء الشيء أو تقدمه في الزمن أو الرتبة أو السير.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem geri dönme veya bir son duruma varmayı hem de sözün varacağı anlamı ortaya çıkarma işlemini açıkça içerir. Dal çerçevesi süreç, sonuç ve yorumlama bağlantısını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel geri dönme ve sonuca varma çekirdeği ile sözü anlamına döndürme, hükmü sahibine verme ve ödül arama kalıpları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin geri dönerek ya da değişerek varacağı son duruma, yere veya sonuca ulaşmasıdır; söz alanında, anlatımı varacağı anlama döndürerek açıklamayı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin geri dönmesi veya sonunda belirli bir duruma varmasıdır.
Bir sözün sonucunu ya da varacağı anlamı açıklamak, geri döndürme çekirdeğinin yorum alanındaki uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geri dönüş, son varış ve sonuç anlamlarında birleşir; sözün açıklanması da onu ulaşacağı anlama veya sonuca bağlayan özel bir kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geri dönüşü, son duruma ulaşmayı ve sözün varacağı anlama bağlanmasını ortak çekirdekte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri dönme, sonuca varma ve anlamı açıklamak üzere ona döndürme bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın süreç sonunda ulaştığı durum yüklemle belirtildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir son duruma varma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Geri dönme ve sözü anlamına döndürerek açıklama yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün neye vardığı veya ne demek olduğu ortaya konurken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü varacağı anlama döndürme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel geri dönüş ve bir son duruma varma yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi belirli bir duruma sokma ve kararın ya da sağlam tutumun varacağı sonucu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir süreç sonunda ulaşılan durumu, varışı veya sonucu anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل يؤول بمعنى رجع أو صار، والمآل والمرجع والمصير، وتأويل الكلام بمعنى ما يؤول إليه أو تفسيره برده إلى معناه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: آل يؤول أى رجع؛ تأويل الكلام وهو عاقبته وما يؤول إليه (maqayis)؛ التأويل تفسير ما يؤول إليه الشئ؛ آل أي رجع (sihah)؛ آل يؤول أي رجع وعاد؛ التأويل المرجع والمصير (tahdhib)

branches.branch_image_ar: آل الرجل من يرجع إليهم ويرجعون إليه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل الرجل: أهل بيته وعياله وقرابته وأتباعه ومن إليه مآل الرجل أو مآلهم إليه، مع استعمال آل فلان في الرجل نفسه على جهة التعبير عنه بآله.
يدخل فيه الإيالة والسياسة، وآل الأمير رعيته إذا ساسها، وآل ماله إذا أصلحه، والائتيال والإصلاح وجمع الأمر أو رد الضالة في الدعاء.

branches.branch_image_ar: خثور السائل وانعقاده في آخر أمره
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل اللبن أو النبات أو القطران أو العسل إذا خثر أو انعقد، والآيل اللبن الخاثر.
يدخل فيه الآل بمعنى الشخص أو ما يتراءى في أول النهار وآخره ويرفع الشخوص، وأطراف الشيء ونواحيه كآل الجبل والبعير والخيمة.

branches.branch_image_ar: آلة الحال التي يكون عليها الشيء
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الآلة أو الألة بمعنى الحالة، كقولهم هو بآلة سوء.
يدخل فيه الآلة بمعنى الأداة، وخشبات الخيمة، والجنازة أو الحامل الذي يحمل عليه.
يدخل فيه الأيل: ذكر الوعول، مع تعليل تسميته بأنه يؤول إلى الجبل يتحصن.
يدخل فيه الإيال: وعاء يجمع فيه الشراب أياما حتى يجود.
يدخل فيه التأويل اسما لنبت أو بقلة ترعاها البهائم، كما ورد في تهذيب اللغة.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, başlangıç ve öncelikten sonuca dönmeye, aile bağından iyi yönetime, fiziksel koyulaşmadan görünür siluete, durum ve araca kadar birçok ayrı dala yayılır; ayrıca bir erkek yabani dağ keçisini, içecek olgunlaştırma kabını ve özel bir yem bitkisini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir işin, yerin veya kişinin işlerinin sorumluluğunu üstlenip yürütmeyi açıkça verir. Yönetim, yetki, görev üstlenme ve yetim ya da kadınla ilgili sorumluluk örnekleri aynı idare etme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yönetim adı, görevli kişi ve işi üstlenme kalıbı aynı dalda ama kapsamları ayrılarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, yerin veya başkasına ait durumun sorumluluğunu üstlenip onu yönetmek ve yürütmektir. Bu, resmi yönetimden bakım ve gözetim sorumluluğuna kadar uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya başkasının durumunu üstlenip yönetme ve yürütme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, bu dalı yönetme, sorumluluk alma, bir yerin veya işin başına geçme ve korunmaya muhtaç kişinin işini yürütme alanında toplar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kökte yakınlık ve aralıksız takip çekirdeğinden yönetme, destek olma, özel toplumsal bağ, yönelme ya da yüz çevirme ve haklı öncelik gibi ilişkisel anlamlar gelişir. Ayrıca yağmur, deve takımı, satış, sürü ayırma ve hurma evresi gibi kalıplaşmış özel adlandırmalar bulunur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإقبال والاستقبال والمقابلة والتقابل والتجاه والعيان والقبل خلاف الدبر وجهة الأمر ووجه الجبل أو الأرض وما يقابل الحس أو النظر

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sonrakine göre önce gelmesini ve henüz gelmemiş yıl ya da gecenin yaklaşmasını aynı öncelik düzeninde toplar. Gençliğin başlangıcı da bu düzenin yaşam evresine uygulanmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel önce ve sonra karşıtlığını korur; gelecek yıl, bundan sonrası ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi biçime ya da kalıba bağlı kullanımları buna karıştırmadan belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından başka bir şeyden önce bulunmasıdır. Yaklaşan yıl ya da gece ile bir yaşam evresinin başlangıcı, bu öncelik çizgisinin ileriye dönük özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey, zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından sonrakinin önünde bulunur.
Henüz gelmemiş yıl veya gece, yaklaşan ve sırada olan dönem diye belirtilir.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, yaşlılık belirtisi henüz görünmeden önceki başlangıç dönemi olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar önce ile sonra arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır ve bu ilişkiyi yaklaşan dönemlere, gelecekteki zamana ve gençliğin ilk evresine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Öncelik ile gelecek dönemin yaklaşmasını tek bir sıra ilişkisi içinde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Önce ve sonra karşıtlığını ve ileriye dönük yaklaşmayı korur.

يدخل فيه القبيل والقبيلة وقبائل العرب وسائر الناس والجماعات والأصناف والعريف الذي يقبل على القوم وكرم الطرفين من النسب
يدخل فيه قبائل الرأس وشعبه وقبال النعل واللجام وسيوره وقبيل الغزل ودبيره والرقاع والأحناء وما ضم بعضه إلى بعض

يدخل فيه القبول وهي الصبا لأنها تقابل الدبور أو تستقبل القبلة

يدخل فيه القبل في سقي الإبل عند ورودها بأن يستقى على رؤوسها أو أفواهها وهي تشرب
يدخل فيه رؤية الهلال أول ما يرى والتكلم أو الإنشاد من غير إعداد واقتبال الأمر واستئنافه وابتداء الشيء بخير أو صلاح

root_profile.summary: Anlam örgüsü karşı karşıya bulunma ve ön yön çekirdeğinden; öncelik, kişiden gelme, olumlu benimseme, ibadet yönü, öpme, karşılama görevi, güvence, soy topluluğu, bağlı parçalar, beden yönlenmesi, karşı rüzgar, yeterlik, deve sulama, başlangıç ve asılı boncuk alanlarına yayılır. Bazı dallar yön ve karşılıklılık üzerinden bağlıyken bazıları yerleşmiş özel nesne, görev veya işlem adlarıdır.

lu_005.text: önce; zaman, yer veya sırada önde

lu_006.text: gelecek veya yaklaşan yıl, gece ve benzeri dönem

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bilgisizliğin karşıtı olan temel zihinsel edinimi, tanımayı ve gerçeğe uygun kavrayışı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun kavrama çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olay veya gelişme hakkındaki haberin kişinin bilgisine ulaşması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin farkına varma ve ondan bilgi edinme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin tekrar ve yönlendirmeyle bir öğrenende yerleşmesini sağlayan öğretim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin aktarılması ve öğrenende kalıcı bir sonuç oluşturması sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişi arasındaki bilgi sınamasında bir tarafın ötekini yenmesi bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi alanındaki karşılaştırmayı ve üstün gelme sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bilen ve bildiğine göre davranan kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haberden haberdar etme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında üstün gelme gibi biçime bağlı uzantıları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, anlamları doğrulama, akletme ve çabuk kavrama yönlerini ayrıca öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve zihnen kavrama alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakın olsa da odak dalın biçime bağlı aktarım ve edinim süreçleri ile komşunun akletme ve hızlı anlama vurgusu karşılıklı değiştirilebilirliği sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi tanıma, gerçeğine uygun kavrama ve bilgi sahibi olma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilginin yokluğu, durumu tanımama veya gerçeğe aykırı bir kanaat bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı zihinsel erişim ekseninin olumlu ve olumsuz uçlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilgiye erişmeyi ve kavramayı bildirirken komşu dal bu erişimin bulunmamasını ya da gerçeğin yanlış bilinmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda yalın bilme ve tanıma, bilginin doğru kullanımından bağımsız olarak çekirdekte yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruyu bulma, yerinde yargı ve bilgiyi isabetli kullanma niteliğini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bilgi sahibi olmayı ve zihinsel kavrayışı paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bilmek tek başına odak dal için yeterli olabilir; komşu dal ise bilginin doğru yargı ve isabetli davranışla birleşmesini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bilme çekirdeğini en çok açıklayan yakın kavrayış dalı, açık karşıtı olan bilgisizlik dalı ve doğru kullanım boyutu taşıyan bilgelik dalı seçildi; öteki adaylar yalnızca uzak çağrışım veya ayrı kök içi anlam alanı sunar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم نقيض الجهل وإدراك الشيء ومعرفته والشعور بالخبر والتعلم والتعليم والإعلام والمغالبة بالعلم
branches.source_phrase_ar: العلم نقيض الجهل (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ علمت الشيء عرفته (sihah;tahdhib)؛ إدراك الشيء بحقيقته (mufradat)؛ ما علمت بخبرك أي ما شعرت به (ayn;tahdhib)؛ أعلمته بكذا وعلمته تعليما (ayn)؛ التعليم تنبيه النفس لتصور المعاني (mufradat)؛ تعلم بمعنى اعلم (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ عالمت الرجل فعلمته (sihah;tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلامة والعلم والراية والجبل والمعلم ومعالم الطريق والحدود وعلم الثوب ورقمه وتعليم الفارس والثوب والقدح والعمامة والحناء إذا جعلت علامة
يدخل فيه العالم والعالمون بمعنى الخلق أو أصناف الخلائق أو كل جنس من الخلق لأنه معلم في نفسه ودال
يدخل فيه العلم والشق في الشفة العليا ووصف الرجل أو البعير بالأعلم إذا كان الشق أو العلم في الموضع الأعلى
يدخل فيه العيلم بمعنى البحر أو البئر الكثيرة الماء
يدخل فيه العلام بمعنى الصقر أو الباشق وما نسب إليه من العلامي
يدخل فيه العيلام بمعنى ذكر الضباع

root_profile.summary: Anlam kümesi bilme, ayırt edici işaret ve yaratılmışlar bütünü arasında açıklanabilir bir ilişki taşırken üst dudak yarığı, deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu, yırtıcı kuş ve erkek sırtlan adları ayrı sözlük dalları oluşturur. Bu nedenle yapı hem ilişkili anlam gelişmelerini hem de birbirinden kopuk adlandırmaları içerir.
